title: Header Action Cleanup: the workspace top row stops acting like a junk drawer

ciFast.note: Fast verification is claimed only after v0.15.88 is pushed and the GitHub Actions run is attached.

deploy.note: Pages deploy is not claimed until the pushed release completes its deploy run.

ciDeep.note: This is a narrow UI-surface cleanup release; component/source regressions plus normal gates are the release bar.

liveProvider.note: The release is based on live browser/source audit of the v0.15.87 working page. A fresh deployed v0.15.88 browser pass should verify the calmer header and Agent panel in production.

manualHuman.note: No external instructor approval is claimed by this release.

claims.summary: The header disclosure is now labeled Project and contains project/file actions rather than package finishing, material upload, or edit-history controls.
The custom agent tools pill no longer appears as a zero-value control unless a sync error needs user attention.
Agent review observations deduplicate inside a digest and the message list renders only the latest digest card, preventing repeated Worth a look stacks.
The release is limited to UI-surface cleanup and carries provider-quality validation forward to a fresh deployed v0.15.88 ZIP/log or browser audit.

carryForward.next: After deploy, verify the header Project menu, hidden zero-tools pill, and deduped Agent notes in the browser, then resume fresh ZIP/log quality audits.
Continue source, texture, local-save, and export-quality audits from fresh provider evidence.
